name: Chicken & Sweetcorn Tacos
method: Slice the chicken into strips, toss with the fajita seasoning and fry in the oil with the garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through.
Shred the cabbage and toss with the juice of one lime and half the coriander.
Mix the drained beans and sweetcorn and warm through in a pan or microwave.
Warm the wraps. Fill with chicken, slaw and the bean and corn mix, then top with yoghurt, the remaining coriander and lime wedges.
